title: Drafts whose check selects a test still to write are re-planned under the no-test-by-default rule
goal: No open item's check or repro is a tests.py -k selector of a test still to write unless the item's component is a critical kind kb/_self/code.md names: each other is given a tool-run check on a planted input or dropped under decision D-2tq4fhgs

run:
import re,subprocess,sys
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','selectors'],capture_output=True,text=True)
n=sum(1 for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if re.match(r'^\s*0\s+NONE',l))
print(n);sys.exit(1 if n or p.returncode else 0)
